directed_by: Joe direct chat 2026-08-23: we know the phenomenology and we know where current physics is in tension; every ledger entry either fits, or would fit given the source action and external datum (deferred), or sits on a current physics-side tension, or the source derives it differently. Build everything possible without returning to the source action; only then is R1 easier.
target_claim_note: installs a work-selection scheme; kills no source claim and no research route

buckets.name: FITS
buckets.definition: the conditional build accommodates it: the construction exists at its rung, conflicts with nothing recorded, and carries a route
buckets.note: this bucket is the goal and the work is to grow it

buckets.name: SOURCE-ACTION-DEFERRED
buckets.definition: it does not fit as built and what it would take is the source action or an external datum
buckets.instruction: do not work these now; log the row and log precisely what would be needed
buckets.note: the accumulated contents of B2 are the R1 specification, assembled for free as a by-product of working the other three buckets

buckets.name: PHYSICS-SIDE TENSION
buckets.definition: the thing GU is asked to reproduce is itself contested, derived under assumptions GU need not share, or measured through a pipeline whose assumptions are visible
buckets.instruction: document the external tension precisely at its own grade and restate what GU is actually obliged to reproduce once the contested part is separated out
buckets.note: not special pleading: it refuses to hold a conjecture to a standard the incumbent theory does not itself meet, and must be sourced to external literature like any other comparator

buckets.name: SOURCE DERIVES IT DIFFERENTLY
buckets.definition: the source material shows a different route to the same phenomenon, so the apparent misfit is an artifact of testing GU against a construction it never proposed
buckets.instruction: identify the source-native route and build that, not the comparator
buckets.note: generalizes the four recurring cases already instrumented in lab/methods/source-native-comparator-routing.md

exhaustion_rule.statement: Do not return to R1 (the source action) or to external-datum construction until B1, B3 and B4 are exhausted. A lane may not select source-action work while any B1, B3 or B4 item remains unattempted.
exhaustion_rule.definition_of_exhausted: every such item has been attempted and has either produced a FITTING_CONSTRUCTION, produced a precise impossibility, or been re-disposed into B2 with its requirement named
reasons: B2 gets cheaper by waiting: every B1 construction fixes a rung interface and narrows what the source action must do, so the R1 problem attacked after exhaustion is strictly smaller and arrives with its specification written

B2 is the only bucket that can absorb unlimited effort with no result: the recorded corpus holds roughly thirty owner-exhausted CBRS-1 closes, and returning to R1 early is the failure mode this rule exists to prevent

disposition_discipline.requires: one bucket per row; a row that seems to be in two is under-analysed and must be split until each part has one bucket
a named requirement: which owner, which coefficient, which datum. 'Needs the source action' is not a disposition and is the blockage restated, which FC-5 already forbids
an external citation: a tension asserted without a published source is an excuse, not a tension. Cite it, scope it, and state what GU still owes once the contested part is removed
the source locus: a registered SC- id or the primary-source passage showing the different route, without which the bucket becomes a way to dismiss any inconvenient comparator

revision_rule: new evidence moves a row between buckets: a B3 tension that resolves against GU moves to B1-or-B2; a B4 route that turns out not to be in the source moves back
what_this_is_not: a way to score the program well: B1 membership earns no prediction credit and moves no ledger row toward SAME
an excuse: B3 relocates and documents an obligation, it does not remove one
a dismissal: B4 says a comparator failure bound a model the source did not propose, which is the existing routing discipline
